# System Software Modules

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-catalog-docs.py. Edit lib/catalog-docs.nix instead. -->

System software modules configure operating system services, desktop sessions, display managers, and shared host behavior.

## base

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Sets core Nix behavior, locale, keyboard layout, zsh support, baseline command-line tools, and the system state version.

Guidance: Use on nearly every host.

## networking

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Convenience import for NetworkManager, firewall, local service discovery, and time sync.

Guidance: Use for normal desktop or laptop networking.

Includes:
- `networkmanager`
- `firewall`
- `avahi`
- `timeSync`

## networkmanager

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables NetworkManager.

Guidance: Use when the host should manage network connections through NetworkManager.

## firewall

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables nftables and firewalld.

Guidance: Use for a managed host firewall.

## avahi

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables local network service discovery and mDNS name resolution.

Guidance: Use when the host should find printers, shares, and local devices on trusted networks.

## timeSync

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables Chrony time synchronization.

Guidance: Use for normal network time sync.

## audioPipewire

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables PipeWire audio with PulseAudio compatibility, ALSA support, 32-bit ALSA support, and realtime scheduling support.

Guidance: Use for modern desktop audio.

## desktopServices

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Convenience import for desktop support services such as Bluetooth, dconf, firmware updates, network shares, power profiles, printing, and removable storage.

Guidance: Use on general-purpose desktop or laptop hosts.

Includes:
- `bluetooth`
- `dconf`
- `firmwareUpdates`
- `networkShares`
- `powerManagement`
- `printing`
- `storageDesktop`

## bluetooth

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables Bluetooth hardware support.

Guidance: Use on hosts that need Bluetooth devices.

## dconf

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables dconf, which GNOME and several GTK applications use for settings.

Guidance: Use with GNOME, GTK-heavy desktops, or Home Manager dconf settings.

## firmwareUpdates

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables fwupd for firmware updates.

Guidance: Use on hardware that receives firmware through LVFS/fwupd.

## networkShares

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Installs SMB/NFS client tools and enables desktop virtual filesystem support for browsing network shares.

Guidance: Use on graphical hosts that should browse or mount common network file shares.

## powerManagement

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables desktop power services and defaults the host to the performance power profile.

Guidance: Use on desktops and laptops where predictable performance is preferred.

## printing

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables printing support.

Guidance: Use when the host needs local or network printers.

## storageDesktop

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables udisks2 for desktop removable-drive handling.

Guidance: Use on graphical hosts where users mount USB drives or external disks.

## desktopKde

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables the KDE Plasma 6 desktop and KDE portal support.

Guidance: Use when you want KDE without the curated KDE app set.

## desktopKdeApps

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Installs curated KDE applications and integration tools, including Dolphin, Kate, Okular, Spectacle, Discover, KDE Connect, and related utilities.

Guidance: Use with KDE when you want a complete desktop app set.

## desktopKdeFull

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Convenience import for KDE Plasma plus the curated KDE app set.

Guidance: Use for a complete KDE system layer.

Includes:
- `desktopKde`
- `desktopKdeApps`

## desktopGnome

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables GNOME and GNOME/GTK portal support.

Guidance: Use when you want GNOME without the curated GNOME app set.

## desktopGnomeApps

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Installs curated GNOME applications and utilities, including Files, Text Editor, Calendar, Calculator, Tweaks, System Monitor, and related tools.

Guidance: Use with GNOME when you want a complete desktop app set.

## desktopGnomeFull

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Convenience import for GNOME plus the curated GNOME app set.

Guidance: Use for a complete GNOME system layer.

Includes:
- `desktopGnome`
- `desktopGnomeApps`

## desktopHyprland

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables Hyprland, UWSM integration, XWayland, and Hyprland/GTK portal support.

Guidance: Use for a Hyprland-capable system layer.

## displaySddm

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables SDDM on Wayland with the Breeze theme and the shared wallpaper.

Guidance: Use with KDE or Hyprland when SDDM should be the login manager.

## displayGdm

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables GDM on Wayland and applies the shared dark wallpaper to the greeter.

Guidance: Use with GNOME or any host that should use GDM as the login manager.

## flatpak

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Enables Flatpak and adds Flathub as a system remote.

Guidance: Use when users should be able to install Flatpak apps.

## fonts

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Installs a practical base font set: Noto, CJK Noto, emoji, Liberation, and DejaVu.

Guidance: Use on graphical hosts or any host that renders user-facing text.

## wallpaper

Layer: `systemSoftware`

Installs the shared wallpaper into `/etc/wallpapers` for display managers and user sessions.

Guidance: Use when display manager and desktop wallpaper should share this repo's visual defaults.
